methods.explanation: Dropping a perpendicular from the far endpoint of the marking line to the aisle forms a right triangle. The 6 m marking line is its hypotenuse, and the depth is the leg opposite \(30^\circ\). In a right triangle, that leg is half the hypotenuse, so the depth is \(6/2=3\) m.
